newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIAN FARMERS GET EU ADVICE WORTH 750,000 ECUS.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIAN FARMERS GET EU ADVICE WORTH 750,000 ECUS.

text.p: Bulgaria's Agriculture Ministry is expected to receive 750,000 European Currency Units for technical advice to farmers under the PHARE programme set up by EU to assist the transition of Eeast European economies.

"The European Union has granted 750.000 Ecus under the PHARE programme for technical advice to the farmers as part of next year's project," deputy agriculture minister Rumen Popov told a news conference.
The extension services will be available for both private and state production farms.
The PHARE Programme has granted technical assistance worth some two million ECUs for the establishment and operation of the National Advisory Service since 1994, added Popov
At present the National Advisory Service has four national centres and 19 regional offices. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
